name: Client statement PDF
description:
##  POST /api/v1/client_statement

Return a PDF of the client statement

You may also pass the query parameter `?send_email=true` to send the statement via email to the client.
whenToUse: Generate a client's statement PDF for a date range, optionally emailing it; use over reports when you need one client's statement (mutating).

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description:
Include child relationships of the Client Object. ie ?include=documents,system_logs

```html
Available includes:

contacts [All contacts related to the client]
documents [All documents related to the client]
gateway_tokens [All payment tokens related to the client]
activities [All activities related to the client]
ledger [The client ledger]
system_logs [System logs related to the client]
group_settings [The group settings object the client is assigned to]

```

Usage:

```html
/api/v1/clients?include=contacts,documents,activities
```

queryParameters.name: send_email
queryParameters.description: When set to true, the statement will also be sent via email to the client.
